assertions.interpretation: The gathering takes place on a cold snowy day, establishing the immediate scene time.
Shortly after the gathering begins, the snow falls more heavily, marking a moment within the scene.
At the moment of the heavy snow, the Grand Tutor (Xie An) delightedly poses the question about what the snow resembles.
Immediately following Xie An's question, his nephew Hu'er offers his comparison of the snow to salt.
Following Hu'er's answer, the niece responds with her comparison of the snow to willow catkins.
Xie An laughs with delight at the niece's answer, concluding the exchange within the scene.
Liu Xiaobiao's annotation records that Xie Lang (Hu'er) later served up to the post of Dongyang Prefect, a later career outcome.
